reason: A read-only Git Graph view for inspecting repository history, branches, references, working-tree changes, commit details, and diffs in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中以只读图形视图查看 Git 提交历史、分支、标签、工作区变更和文件差异。
summaries.en: A read-only Git graph view for exploring commit history, branches, tags, working-tree changes, and file diffs in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Reads Git repository history, references, status, commit details, file contents, diffs, and comparisons
Provides a dedicated interactive Git graph view with filtering, search, and display settings
Exposes a read-only model tool for querying bounded Git history and repository data
